ai.note: Design note. The weights are the Revision 7 computer player's constants (computerWeights, offensiveWeights, stakeWeights and victoryAlarm), moved into data unchanged, one profile per faction so a harness variant can change one side (E7, H4). The blunder chance is 1 in 100 orders (H6, Q-MR-33). The Build budget (EB-15) is economy-builds' starting value: builds spend at most 60 percent of what Recruit orders leave, at most 3 orders a turn, one new item per sub-territory with an empty queue; a design note for the harness to tune (H7). Design note (D23, D24, m3r1-ai-fixes): victoryAlarm.critical raises, by 1 + 3, the stake of a territory whose change of hands alone would decide the game: own ground a rival in reach would win by taking, and ground the faction itself would win by taking. It sits above the x2.5 the alarm gives a leader's territory one step short, so holding the deciding ground outranks attacking the leader, and taking it is weighed as much as holding it. withdraw.hopelessTakeChance 0.5: the computer player gives up contested ground when the standing battle is at least even odds to take it whole this turn, by the engine's own odds. withdraw.lastStandTakeChance 0.75: its seat, last objective or a victory-critical territory is given up only when it would be lost whole at least three times in four. Starting values, not tuned.

factions.name: Republican Government
factions.motivation: Defend Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, and the loyal northern cities.

briefing.objective: Hold the Republic together. You keep Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, and the northern coast, but the rising has split the country in two. Win by holding 10 of 18 territories or 19 of 25 cities.
briefing.firstTurnHint: Reports from Toledo say columns are moving north out of Andalucía, and the northern command is gathering beyond the Sierra de Guadarrama. Madrid has two regiments, its guards, and the militia columns holding the passes. Do we keep them all in the capital, or send some forward to meet the southern columns before they arrive?

factions.note: Design note: starting treasuries before any income ($7). The Republic holds the Bank of Spain's reserves; the harness tunes the numbers. The seat is where replacement generals appear (declog D7).

factions.name: Northern Insurgent Command
factions.motivation: Drive toward Madrid and connect the northern insurgent zone.

briefing.objective: Link the insurgent zone and take Madrid. You hold Castilla y León, Navarra, Galicia, and Zaragoza, and your garrison in Oviedo is besieged; the Basque coast and Santander sit behind your lines.
briefing.firstTurnHint: Zaragoza's garrison reports militia columns leaving Barcelona for Aragón, and in Asturias the miners have Oviedo surrounded. Do we hold Aragón and relieve Oviedo, or send the requetés and the Sierra columns south toward Madrid while the Republic is still organizing?

factions.note: Design note: starting treasuries before any income ($7). The Republic holds the Bank of Spain's reserves; the harness tunes the numbers. The seat is where replacement generals appear (declog D7).

factions.name: Southern Insurgent Command
factions.motivation: Expand from Sevilla and the African bridgeheads toward Madrid.

briefing.objective: Bring the Army of Africa across the Strait and march on Madrid. You hold Sevilla, Córdoba, Cádiz, and Granada, and the first of the Army of Africa has landed at Sevilla; most of the Legion and the Regulares still wait in Ceuta and Melilla.
briefing.firstTurnHint: The vanguard flown into Sevilla is ready to march, but most of the Legion and the Regulares are still in Africa, and every day they stay there gives the Republic time to organize. Do we bring them across now, or push north with the vanguard and the regiments in Andalucía and let Africa follow?

factions.note: Design note: starting treasuries before any income ($7). The Republic holds the Bank of Spain's reserves; the harness tunes the numbers. The seat is where replacement generals appear (declog D7).

units.name: Wad-Ras Infantry Regiment No. 1
units.historicalNote: Stayed loyal at Carabanchel after its general was killed by his own soldiers. Present strength estimated from I Division's barracks figures, less losses to the dissolution of 18-19 July.

sources.reference: infantry regiment list; I Division barracks-strength row

units.name: Madrid Sierra Columns
units.historicalNote: The mixed columns of soldiers, guards, and militia holding the Guadarrama and Somosierra passes. Estimated as a fraction of the militia raised in Madrid.

units.name: Barcelona Assault and Civil Guards

sources.reference: citing Thomas (1976), p. 275; Martinez Bande (2007), pp. 305-306

units.historicalNote: The Assault and Civil Guards who, with the CNT, defeated the rising in Barcelona, where the Badajoz and Alcantara regiments rose and lost.

units.name: Durruti Column
units.historicalNote: Left Barcelona for the Aragon front on 24 July with about 2,500 men. The figure is unfootnoted.

units.name: Catalan Militia Columns
units.historicalNote: The other CNT and party columns leaving Barcelona for Aragon. Estimated as a fraction of the armed CNT men in the city after the rising.

units.name: Otumba Infantry Regiment No. 9

units.name: Guadalajara Infantry Regiment No. 10
units.historicalNote: The Valencia garrison stayed in barracks until workers stormed them about eight days after the rising. Strength estimated as for Otumba No. 9.

sources.reference: infantry regiment list (citing the Nafziger Collection); VII Division barracks-strength row

It stands in País Vasco, where units are territory-level.

development.name: Farms
development.note: $3, Q-ECON-1: food folds into Manpower; one Manpower is about 1,000 men. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

development.name: Mines
development.note: $3. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

development.name: Industry
development.note: $3: city sub-territories only. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.note: R3: gates infantry, security forces and cavalry. D28.4: built only in a capital sub-territory, the only place it unlocks anything. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

buildings.name: Factory
buildings.note: R3, D7: one more Recruit order a turn. D28.4: built only in a capital sub-territory, the only place it unlocks anything. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

buildings.name: Depot
buildings.note: $4, D28.1: materiel on hand makes Replenish cost 25 percent less Funds; it also gates trucks and tanks (R3). Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

buildings.name: Fortifications
buildings.note: $4. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

buildings.name: Hospital
buildings.note: R5, D28.1: the per-turn Replenish cap rises from half the establishment to three quarters. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

buildings.name: Airfield
buildings.note: U2. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

buildings.name: Paved airfield
buildings.note: U2: flies in Mud and Snow. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

buildings.name: Rail yard
buildings.note: M3: one more army by rail a turn from its capital. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

improvements.note: $4, $8. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7).

d20.note: D1-D7: the 13-grade catalogue (Q-MR-06), today's modifiers x3 (Q-D20-6), fatigue (Q-MR-04), break-up at 10 percent (Q-MR-08). Column k reads grade floor((score + 3k + 4) / 3), with scores 0-1 destroying the attacker at 1:1 and below (Q-D20-1 note); a starting table for the harness to tune.

weather.note: Design note: four zones (Q-WX-2), six outcomes (Q-WX-4), soft attack modifiers (Q-WX-6, D7), rain closing the sea in winter (Q-MR-30) and 5 percent frostbite (D7). Each table runs best to worst (T2); the band widths follow each zone's seasonal climate and are for the harness to tune.

calendar.note: T1: half-month turns from Late July 1936 (Q-MR-31).

air.note: U3, U4 and declog D7. Design note: a starting value for the harness to tune (Q-MR-26, H7). generalDeathRoll 4 (a 1 in 5 chance that a general dies when his army is destroyed or routed) is a design note for the harness to tune (U5, Q-MR-28).

generals.note: Rosters of real 1936-1939 commanders in the order they could take command (U5, Q-MR-28). Each trait is a design note, a nudge to keep or sack him, not a historical verdict.
